summary: The 2026-10-02 session closed with the composite essentially flat at 52.37 and a trend_1d of 0.2 - still caution, still goldilocks - while the tape itself was constructive: 16 of the 22 sectors and themes rose, led by autos at 5.6762, semiconductor equipment at 3.9866 and networking at 3.3455, against 6 decliners whose deepest fall was memory at -2.404. NVDA rose 1.5139 to 234.354996, TSLA 5.6762, AVGO 3.6055 and AMD 3.1605, with MU the outlier at -2.2307. The day's anomaly is that the soft employment print bought no relief at the long end: payrolls printed 29.0 against 133.0 the prior month and unemployment rose to 4.2 from 4.1, yet the 10Y rose to 5.29 from 5.26 and the real rate to 2.93 from 2.91, both pinned at the 100th percentile, while the 2Y eased only to 4.88 from 4.89 - bear-steepening the curve to 0.41 from 0.37. Credit widened again (HY OAS 3.24 from 3.12, IG 0.86 from 0.84); the largest single contribution stays cross-asset confirmation at 7.5 on a reading of only 0.5; participation remains narrow at 12 new highs against 21 new lows of 156 names with breadth at 0.6; and the policy path is still priced as a hike at an implied 4.075 against an effective funds rate of 3.88. The A-share leg cannot be reported: the Shanghai exchange is closed for Golden Week from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07, so the CN series still carries the 2026-09-30 close.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Macro is the binding constraint at 68.94: payrolls printed 29.0 against 133.0 the prior month and unemployment rose to 4.2 from 4.1, yet the 10Y rose to 5.29 from 5.26 and the real rate to 2.93 from 2.91, both pinned at the 100th percentile - the soft print bought no relief at the long end.

Cross-asset confirmation remains the single largest contribution at 7.5 on a reading of just 0.5, with the dollar at 120.33, the real rate at 2.93 and small-cap relative at -8.2427 all still triggering.
Liquidity and credit is the dimension on the rise at 65.29 as spreads widen for a second session: HY OAS 3.24 from 3.12 and IG 0.86 from 0.84.
The advance is thin: breadth is 0.6 with 93 of 155 names above the 200-day average, 12 new highs against 21 new lows of 156, and small-cap relative at -8.2427.
The priced policy path and the front end disagree: the market still prices a hike at an implied 4.075 against an effective funds rate of 3.88, while the 2Y eased to 4.88 from 4.89.

supporting_signals.claim: The real rate stays pinned at the 100th percentile at 2.93, keeping discount-rate pressure on equity valuations.
HY OAS at 3.24 is the second-largest contribution at 6.0152, and credit has now widened for a second session.
Participation is inverted: 12 new highs against 21 new lows of 156 names, with the new-lows ratio at 0.1346 against a new-highs ratio of 0.0769.
Small caps are not confirming the index-level advance, with small-cap relative at -8.2427.
The reserve-scarcity signal persists: RRP refilled to 1.501 from 0.35 on a same-day 2026-10-02 vintage, but the level is still at only the 10.18th percentile and scores 79.63 on the risk scale.

contradicting_signals.claim: The tape was broad: 16 of the 22 sectors and themes rose, led by autos at 5.6762, semiconductor equipment at 3.9866 and networking at 3.3455, with only 6 lower and the deepest fall memory at -2.404.
Semiconductor relative strength sits near neutral at -0.9639, so the sector is no longer the drag it was for most of the quarter.

Volatility is contained and still falling: the volatility dimension is the lowest at 24.9, with VIX at 16.39 and realized volatility at 10.3618 - though the VIX observation carries a 2026-10-01 vintage rather than the 2026-10-02 session.
Trend structure remains positive: price is 6.8342 above the 200-day average and the 52-week drawdown is only -1.0503.
Equities are rising even as the discount rate rises: NVDA gained 1.5139 to 234.354996, AVGO 3.6055, AMD 3.1605 and TSLA 5.6762, while only MU fell at -2.2307.

what_changed_today: The composite held at 52.37 with a trend_1d of only 0.2, so the day's risk repricing was absorbed without a headline score move.
The employment report was the day's release: payrolls 29.0 against 133.0 the prior month, unemployment 4.2 from 4.1, and participation 61.8 from 61.6.

The long end rose against a soft print: the 10Y moved to 5.29 from 5.26 and the real rate to 2.93 from 2.91, both at the 100th percentile, while the 2Y eased to 4.88 from 4.89 and the curve bear-steepened to 0.41 from 0.37.
Credit spreads widened again: HY OAS to 3.24 from 3.12 and IG to 0.86 from 0.84.
RRP refilled to 1.501 from 0.35 on a same-day 2026-10-02 vintage, yet the level is still only at the 10.18th percentile.
Leadership rotated into autos and semis: autos 5.6762, semiconductor equipment 3.9866, networking 3.3455 and semiconductors 2.4014, while memory at -2.404 was the deepest decliner.
New highs recovered to 12 against 21 new lows of 156 names with breadth at 0.6 - the advance is wider than a session ago but still inverted.
The policy path is still priced as a hike at an implied 4.075 against an effective funds rate of 3.88, unchanged in direction from the prior session.
The A-share leg went dark: the Shanghai exchange is closed for Golden Week from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08, so the CN series still shows the 2026-09-30 close.
watch_next: Whether the 10Y holds above its prior observation of 5.26, now 5.29, once the soft payrolls print is absorbed - or whether the long end keeps climbing.
Whether the front end and the priced policy path converge, given an implied 4.075 against an effective funds rate of 3.88.
Whether credit widening extends, after HY OAS moved to 3.24 from 3.12 and IG to 0.86 from 0.84.
Whether participation broadens beyond 12 new highs against 21 new lows of 156 names.
The A-share leg stays unconfirmable until the Shanghai exchange reopens on 2026-10-08, and the CN series will keep reporting the 2026-09-30 close until then.
Whether the volatility observation catches up: VIX is 16.39 on a 2026-10-01 vintage while the fact layer is a 2026-10-02 layer.
The next high-importance macro release is CPI on 2026-10-14, with earnings season opening through PEP on 2026-10-08 and DAL on 2026-10-09.
